test_title: PYST 13: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 23 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which number will replace the question mark (?) in the following series?

1, 6, 12, 26, 67, 172, ?
solution:
**Logic: **Double difference between the numbers is the cube of numbers starting from 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41a5b1ccfca00415d3a88abde396380955fbe8cd06daca91edf3857c3ca49eeb.png] 

As it can be seen that the obtained number is **"402".**

Hence, the correct answer is **"402".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**

It is better to remember cubes up to at least 10.
